title: Bithumb says victims of October internal-system data leak exceed 7,159 and leak period was Oct 12 to 27
date_note: Date of Bithumb's updated announcement as reported by PANews on 25 November; the leak itself occurred in October.
summary: PANews, citing Seoul Economic Daily, reports that Bithumb now says more people were affected than the 7,159 announced earlier (6,444 customers and 715 employees and partner staff), without giving a new total. The leak period was extended from about one hour on 27 October to 12 to 27 October. Leaked items now include occupation and employer.
plain: Bithumb says more people were hit by its October internal-system leak than the 7,159 announced earlier, and the leak period was longer than first stated. It has not given a new total.
exec: Bithumb says the October leak affected more than the 7,159 people announced earlier, over a longer period.
geo_basis: country of the South Korean exchange; city not stated

evidence.quote: 确认个人信息泄露受害者人数已超过此前公布的7159人（客户6444人及员工、合作方员工715人），但暂未公布具体规模。
泄露期间也由此前所称的10月27日约1小时延长至10月12日至27日，外部未授权人员在此期间访问该系统并擅自导出个人信息及文件，泄露项目新增职业、工作单位等信息。

validation.note: Only PANews (relaying Seoul Economic Daily and a Bithumb announcement) read; Bithumb's own notice and the Korean original were not read.

review.note: title, 7,159 figure, Oct 12-27 period, new items checked against PANews; single_source
